description: This file is a shell script containing test cases and setup functions for testing git merge behavior, specifically merge scenarios involving renames, directory renames, conflicts, and dirty modifications.

methods.name: test_setup_1a
methods.description: Initializes a git repository and sets up a no-rename merge scenario with specific commits representing base, branch A, and branch B.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A macro function used throughout the script to assert successful execution of tests with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_setup_2a
methods.description: Sets up a merge scenario with a file rename on branch B and no changes on A.

methods.name: test_setup_2b
methods.description: Sets up a scenario with changes on A, a rename on B, and configures for merge testing.

methods.name: test_setup_2c
methods.description: Sets up a more complex scenario involving changes on A, renames, and potential conflict situations.

methods.name: test_setup_3a
methods.description: Prepares a directory rename scenario with changes and renames within subdirectories.

methods.name: test_setup_3b
methods.description: Prepares a scenario with directory renames combined with changes.

methods.name: test_setup_4a
methods.description: Sets up a scenario where local modifications exist alongside merge changes.

methods.name: test_setup_4b
methods.description: Prepares a scenario combining renames and local modifications to test merge behavior under dirty working copy states.
